purpose: Bind the Founder Control Room and Chief AI standalone-peer authority and publication contract to current durable documentation so pair identity, cross-system evidence, posting approval, and provider-readback semantics cannot change while Documentation Truth reports a false green.

claims: `config/founder-chief-pair.contract.json` must remain a Documentation Truth input under pair-authority and publishing so standalone-peer and publication-approval changes cannot green without current durable docs and receipt evidence.

`scripts/verify-documentation-truth.mjs` must classify the Founder-Chief pair contract under pair-authority and publishing and must require the current README, merge-authority documentation, public-communication contract, truth-decay audit, and path-bound receipt.
`README.md` must describe the Founder-Chief pair contract as a load-bearing control-plane truth surface while keeping separate peer receipts, failures, continuity markers, and authority classes.
`docs/FOUNDER_MERGE_AUTHORITY.md` must keep the standalone-peer pair contract non-authorizing for merge, deploy, provider mutation, publication, secrets, and destructive actions.
`docs/PUBLIC_COMMUNICATION_TRUTH_CONTRACT.md` must preserve exact Current You approval and provider readback even when the pair contract names an approved automation or posting class.
`docs/TRUTH_DECAY_AUDIT.md` must record the pair-authority and publishing classification repair so a future pair-contract change cannot silently return to a zero-sensitive-file false green.
